name: Wise Yak 7
author: Siyu1017
description: Gradient rounded lime button that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, box-shadow becomes -4px -4px 32px 4px #e5fb6a67,
    4px 4px 32px 4px #2bf46e67, filter becomes contrast(1.25). On focus, box-shadow becomes -4px -4px 32px 4px #e5fb6a67,
    4px 4px 32px 4px #2bf46e67.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Wise Yak 7</title>
<style>
/* Wise Yak 7 by Siyu1017 — https://uiverse.io/Siyu1017/wise-yak-7 */
.button {
  --color-1: #e5fb6a;
  --color-2: #2bf46e;
  --color-1-shadow: #e5fb6a23;
  --color-2-shadow: #2bf46e23;
  --color-1-shadow-focus: #e5fb6a67;
  --color-2-shadow-focus: #2bf46e67;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  border: 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    to right bottom,
    var(--color-1) 0%,
    var(--color-2) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    -4px -4px 16px 8px var(--color-1-shadow),
    4px 4px 16px 8px var(--color-2-shadow);
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.6, 0.12, 0.39, 0.83);
}

.button:hover,
.button:active,
.button:focus,
.button:focus-visible,
.button:focus-within {
  box-shadow:
    -4px -4px 32px 4px var(--color-1-shadow-focus),
    4px 4px 32px 4px var(--color-2-shadow-focus);
}

.button:hover {
  filter: contrast(1.25);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Awesome Button</button>

</body>
</html>
